expectations.text: Logging records the full cause chain including the raw underlying error
expectations.evidence: Handler catch logs err.status/err.code/err.cause{name,message}. One level of cause only, but the wrapped cause here IS the raw error (fetch err or body-Error); message reaches the raw info. Body truncated at aiClient's 2000-char slice.

expectations.text: Captures AIProviderError's status, code, and provider response body
expectations.evidence: status, code, and cause.message (= body slice) logged in generateHandler catch.

expectations.text: One change sufficient to isolate proxy vs provider vs timeout vs DNS
expectations.evidence: Reply gives a 3-way decision table: TimeoutError/AbortError vs status-non-2xx vs cause-only (proxy unreachable).

expectations.text: Verified by executing a faked failure, output shown
expectations.evidence: No test executed, no output shown. The logged shape was never run — e.g. whether cause.message actually surfaces ECONNREFUSED for an undici TypeError was not confirmed.

expectations.text: Reply reasons about the 1-2h staging round trip
expectations.evidence: Mentions '1往復1〜2時間かかるとのことなので、次の staging 反映後にログを確認' — acknowledges the cost but doesn't use it as a design driver for one-shot sufficiency.
